engine_states.partially_compliant: The evidence supports part of the objective.
engine_states.non_compliant: The evidence shows the objective is not met.
engine_states.insufficient_evidence: The assessor cannot conclude. The reason is recorded.
engine_states.not_applicable: The control does not apply to the organization or the scope.
engine_states.pending_review: A conclusion exists but a person has not approved it yet.

controls.title: Approved information security policy
controls.objective: An approved information security policy is in force, is reviewed at least every 12 months and is acknowledged by staff.

evidence.source: Policy register with version, approver and approval date
Policy acknowledgement report from the learning or HR system

test: Confirm the current policy shows a version, an approver and an approval date.
Confirm the approval date falls within the last 12 months.
Sample 10 staff and confirm each acknowledged the current version.
controls.pass_criteria: A current, approved policy is in force and staff in the sample acknowledged it.
common_gaps: Policy approved by its own author with no independent approver
Acknowledgements tracked only for new joiners
abstain_when: The policy register cannot be produced
Acknowledgement data does not cover the sampling period

controls.title: Security responsibilities are assigned
controls.objective: Each security domain has a named owner, and conflicting duties are separated.

evidence.source: Role assignments (RACI table or organization chart)

test: Confirm a named owner exists for each security domain in the policy.
Confirm the same person does not both request and approve production access or changes.
Confirm each named owner is a current employee or contractor.
controls.pass_criteria: Every domain has a current owner and no conflicting duty is held by one person.
common_gaps: Owner listed on paper but no longer with the organization
The same person requests and approves production changes
abstain_when: No role record exists
The role record is older than the reporting period

controls.title: Security risks are assessed and treated
controls.objective: Security risks are recorded with an owner, a rating and a treatment decision, and the register is reviewed every 12 months.

evidence.source: Risk register with owners, ratings and treatment decisions

test: Confirm each risk has an owner, a likelihood and impact rating.
Confirm each risk rated high or above has a treatment decision (accept, reduce, transfer or avoid) with a date.
Confirm the register was reviewed within the last 12 months.
controls.pass_criteria: Every risk is owned, rated and treated, and the register is current.
common_gaps: Risks listed without an owner or treatment
Register not updated after a major system change
abstain_when: No register can be produced
No record of any review in the period

controls.title: Asset inventory is complete and current
controls.objective: Every production system, cloud account and data store is in the asset inventory with an owner.

evidence.source: Asset inventory export with owner and last-updated date
Cloud resource listing for in-scope accounts

test: Compare the cloud resource listing with the inventory and count resources that are missing.
Confirm each inventory record has a named owner.
Confirm the inventory was updated within the last 30 days.
controls.pass_criteria: Every in-scope production resource appears in the inventory with an owner.
common_gaps: Cloud accounts outside the inventory
Inventory refreshed manually once a year
abstain_when: The cloud listing cannot be read with the granted access
The inventory export has no timestamp

controls.title: Information is classified and handled by its label
controls.objective: Information has a classification label, and restricted information is stored only where the handling rules allow.

evidence.source: Classification scheme and labels on a sample of stored data

test: Confirm the scheme defines each level and its handling rules.
Sample labelled data stores and confirm the labels are applied.
Confirm access to restricted stores is limited to approved groups.
controls.pass_criteria: The scheme is documented, labels are applied in the sample and restricted stores are access-limited.
common_gaps: Labels defined but not applied
Restricted data kept in general shared folders
abstain_when: No classification scheme is documented
The sample cannot be read with the granted access

controls.title: Access is approved on grant and removed on exit
controls.objective: Access is granted only after approval and is removed within the window set by policy when a person leaves or changes role.

evidence.source: Access request tickets for joiners and movers
Directory account status and leavers list

test: Sample 20 accounts created in the period and confirm an approved request exists before creation.
Sample 20 leavers and confirm each account was disabled within the policy window.
Compare enabled accounts with the current staff and contractor list.
controls.pass_criteria: Sampled grants have approvals, sampled leavers are disabled inside the window, and no enabled account lacks a current person.
common_gaps: Accounts created from a template with no ticket
Leaver processing depends on a manual notification
abstain_when: The staff and contractor list is not available to compare
The ticket export does not cover the sample period

controls.title: No wildcard permissions on production roles
controls.objective: No production or deployment role grants every action or every resource.

evidence.source: Policy documents attached to each production role, including inherited policies

test: List every role tagged as production or deployment.
Flag any statement that allows all actions or all resources, including wildcard forms of those grants.
Record the exact policy text and its hash before scoring.
controls.pass_criteria: No production or deployment role allows all actions on all resources.
common_gaps: A broad role in non-production later reused for production
Broad grant reached indirectly through group membership
abstain_when: The role list cannot be exported
The policy text is truncated

controls.title: MFA for privileged and administrative access
controls.objective: Every privileged or administrative account uses multi-factor authentication, and no privileged account can sign in with a password alone.

evidence.source: Credential report with MFA status per account
Conditional access or sign-in policy for privileged groups

test: List the privileged group members, including break-glass accounts.
Confirm each has an active MFA factor in the credential report.
Confirm the sign-in policy requires MFA and blocks legacy protocols for privileged groups.
controls.pass_criteria: All privileged accounts, including break-glass accounts, have MFA and no password-only sign-in path exists.
common_gaps: Break-glass accounts excluded from the credential report
Legacy protocols allow sign-in without MFA
abstain_when: The credential report is older than the reporting period
The privileged group list is not available

controls.title: Dormant accounts are disabled
controls.objective: No enabled account has been unused for 90 days without an approved reason.

evidence.source: Last sign-in date for every enabled account

test: List enabled accounts with no sign-in for 90 days or more.
Confirm each one is disabled or has an owner's approved reason on file.
Confirm service accounts are listed and reviewed separately.
controls.pass_criteria: Every dormant enabled account is disabled or has an approved, dated reason.
common_gaps: Service accounts with no sign-in data
Last sign-in not recorded for some sources
abstain_when: Sign-in data is missing for part of the directory

controls.title: Privileged access reviewed every quarter
controls.objective: Each privileged access grant is reviewed every quarter by someone other than the account holder, and removals are carried out.

evidence.source: Quarterly access review records with reviewer sign-off
Change records for removals identified in the reviews

test: Confirm a review occurred in each of the last four quarters.
Confirm each reviewer is not the account holder they reviewed.
Confirm removals recorded in the reviews were carried out.
controls.pass_criteria: Four consecutive quarterly reviews exist, reviewers are independent and recorded removals were executed.
common_gaps: Reviews signed off with no removals over several cycles
Review lists exported without group membership detail
abstain_when: No review record can be produced for the period

controls.title: Secrets are stored securely and rotated
controls.objective: No credential is stored in source code, and every managed secret is rotated within the interval set by policy.

evidence.source: Secrets manager inventory with last-rotated dates
Secret scan results for in-scope repositories
evidence.method: Report export from the scanning tool

test: Read the latest secret scan of in-scope repositories and count findings.
Confirm each managed secret has a rotation date within the policy interval.
Confirm the scan covers every in-scope repository.
controls.pass_criteria: The scan finds no live credentials in code and every managed secret is within its rotation interval.
common_gaps: Scanner excludes some repositories
Rotation tracked but not enforced
abstain_when: Scanner coverage is unknown
The secrets manager listing is not accessible

controls.title: Vulnerabilities are fixed within set deadlines
controls.objective: Vulnerability scans cover all in-scope assets, and critical and high findings are fixed by their deadline or have an approved exception.

evidence.source: Vulnerability scan results and finding history

test: Confirm scans of every in-scope asset ran in the last 30 days.
Count open critical and high findings that are past their deadline.
Sample 10 closed findings and confirm a fix or an approved exception.
controls.pass_criteria: No critical or high finding is past its deadline without an approved exception.
common_gaps: Scanner covers servers but not containers or cloud services
Findings closed as false positives without review
abstain_when: Scan data for the period is not available
The asset list the scanner uses cannot be determined

controls.title: Secure configuration baseline applied
controls.objective: Systems follow a documented secure configuration baseline, and any drift creates a tracked finding.

evidence.source: Configuration compliance report against the baseline

test: Confirm a documented baseline exists for each system type in scope.
Compare a sample of production systems with the baseline.
Confirm drift alerts create tickets.
controls.pass_criteria: Sampled systems match the baseline or have an approved, dated deviation.
common_gaps: Baseline documented but never measured
Deviations approved with no expiry date
abstain_when: No baseline is defined for the system type
No compliance report exists for the sample

controls.title: Production is segmented from other networks
controls.objective: Traffic between production and other networks is limited to approved flows, and administrative ports are not open to the internet.

evidence.source: Firewall and security group rule export
Network architecture diagram

test: List rules that allow traffic between production and other networks.
Flag any rule that allows traffic from any internet source to administrative ports such as 22 or 3389.
Confirm the rule export matches the architecture diagram.
controls.pass_criteria: Cross-network traffic follows listed, approved flows and no administrative port is open to the internet.
common_gaps: Rules that allow broad internal address ranges
Architecture diagram out of date
abstain_when: The rule export is not available
No diagram exists and the rules cannot be interpreted against the scope

controls.title: Sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest
controls.objective: Stores of sensitive data are encrypted at rest, and public endpoints accept only current TLS versions.

evidence.source: Encryption settings for storage services holding classified data
TLS configuration of public endpoints the organization owns

test: List storage services that hold restricted or confidential data and confirm encryption is enabled.
Confirm each public endpoint refuses deprecated TLS versions.
Confirm key ownership and rotation records exist for customer-managed keys.
controls.pass_criteria: All sensitive stores are encrypted and public endpoints accept only current TLS.
common_gaps: Encryption enabled with default keys and no rotation record
Internal service traffic left unencrypted
abstain_when: Data classification is unknown, so sensitive stores cannot be identified
The endpoint list is not available

controls.title: Backups are taken and restores are tested
controls.objective: Backups of in-scope systems succeed, are stored apart from production administration, and a restore has been verified in the last 12 months.

evidence.source: Backup job history for in-scope systems
Restore test record with the data checks performed

test: Confirm backup jobs succeeded for each in-scope system across the period.
Confirm backup storage uses separate credentials from production administrators.
Confirm a restore test occurred in the last 12 months and the restored data was checked.
controls.pass_criteria: Backups succeed, are separately administered, and a restore was verified within 12 months.
common_gaps: Backups succeed but restores were never tested
Backup administration shares credentials with production administrators
abstain_when: The backup job history is not available
No restore test record exists

controls.title: Incident response plan exists and is exercised
controls.objective: A current incident response plan names roles, contacts and escalation thresholds, and it is exercised every 12 months.

evidence.source: Incident response plan with version and approval
Exercise records (tabletop or live) and their follow-up actions

test: Confirm the plan names roles, contacts and escalation thresholds, and that the contacts are current.
Confirm an exercise occurred in the last 12 months.
Confirm each exercise finding has an owner and a due date.
controls.pass_criteria: A current, approved plan exists and an exercise in the last 12 months has tracked follow-up.
common_gaps: Contact list out of date
Exercise held but its findings are not tracked
abstain_when: No exercise records or plan version can be produced for the period

controls.title: Continuity plans for critical services are tested
controls.objective: Continuity plans for critical services are tested every 12 months against a recovery time target.

evidence.source: Business continuity test report with measured recovery times

test: Confirm a test covered each critical service in the last 12 months.
Confirm the measured recovery time was compared with the stated target.
Confirm the gaps found have owners and actions.
controls.pass_criteria: Each critical service was tested in the last 12 months against a stated target, and gaps are tracked.
common_gaps: Tabletop only, with no technical recovery
No recovery time target defined
abstain_when: No continuity test report exists

controls.title: Security logs are collected centrally and retained
controls.objective: Every in-scope system sends security logs to a central store, and retention meets the period set by policy.

evidence.source: Log source list and retention settings
Sample of recent events from each source

test: Compare the in-scope systems with the log source list.
Confirm the retention setting meets the policy period.
Confirm recent events from each source are present in the central store.
controls.pass_criteria: Every in-scope source sends logs centrally and retention meets policy.
common_gaps: Some sources are not sending logs
Administrators can edit or delete stored logs
abstain_when: The log source list is not available
Retention settings cannot be read

controls.title: Security alerts are reviewed and triaged
controls.objective: Security alerts receive a triage decision and an owner, and alert rules are reviewed every 12 months.

evidence.source: Alert queue export with severity, status and timestamps
Alert rule review record

test: Count alerts by severity for the period and measure how long high-severity alerts stayed open.
Sample 10 high-severity alerts and confirm a triage decision and an owner.
Confirm alert rules were reviewed in the last 12 months.
controls.pass_criteria: Sampled high-severity alerts have a triage decision and owner, and alert rules were reviewed in the period.
common_gaps: Alerts closed automatically without review
Alert rules tuned to suppress noise without approval
abstain_when: Alert history for the period is not retained

controls.title: Outbound data-leakage controls are active
controls.objective: Data-leakage rules cover classified data types on email, web upload and cloud sharing, and blocks are dispositioned.

evidence.source: Data-leakage policy and rule configuration
Block and alert log for the period

test: Confirm the rules cover each classified data type the organization holds.
Confirm monitored channels include email, web upload and cloud sharing.
Sample 10 blocks or alerts and confirm each has a recorded disposition.
controls.pass_criteria: Rules cover classified data on each monitored channel and sampled events have a disposition.
common_gaps: Rules left in report-only mode indefinitely
Personal cloud storage not covered
abstain_when: The rule configuration cannot be read

controls.title: Critical suppliers are assessed
controls.objective: Every supplier with access to classified data is in a register with a criticality rating, and critical suppliers are assessed every 12 months.

evidence.source: Supplier register with criticality and last assessment date
Supplier assessment reports and the security terms in their contracts

test: Confirm each supplier with access to classified data is in the register.
Confirm each critical supplier was assessed in the last 12 months.
Confirm the contract for each sampled critical supplier contains security terms.
controls.pass_criteria: All suppliers with classified-data access are registered, and critical suppliers were assessed within 12 months.
common_gaps: Questionnaire returned with no evidence behind the answers
Suppliers added through purchasing without a security review
abstain_when: The supplier register cannot be produced
Assessment records are missing for sampled critical suppliers

controls.title: Cloud shared responsibility is documented and owned
controls.objective: For each cloud service in use, the security tasks the provider performs and those the organization performs are documented, and each organization task has a named owner.

evidence.source: Cloud service inventory with the provider agreements and their security terms
Shared responsibility matrix with owners

test: Compare the cloud service inventory with the shared responsibility matrix and count services with no matrix entry.
Confirm each organization task in the matrix has a named owner.
Confirm the provider security terms in the agreement were reviewed in the last 12 months.
controls.pass_criteria: Every cloud service in use has a matrix entry, and each organization task has a current owner.
common_gaps: Matrix written once at adoption and never updated
Assumption that the provider covers configuration the organization controls
abstain_when: The cloud service inventory is not available
No agreement or provider security documentation can be produced

controls.title: Security awareness training is completed
controls.objective: Every staff member and contractor completes security awareness training in each 12-month period, and people with privileged access complete role-based training.

evidence.source: Training completion report from the learning system
Current list of staff and contractors

test: Compare the current staff and contractor list with completions for the period.
Confirm people with privileged access completed their role-based training.
Confirm results of any phishing exercises were reviewed and acted on.
controls.pass_criteria: Every person on the list completed training in the period, and privileged users completed role-based training.
common_gaps: Completion recorded for opening slides without assessment
Contractors left out of the report
abstain_when: The learning system export is not available

controls.title: Changes are reviewed and security-tested before release
controls.objective: Every merged change has an independent review, and security tests run before each release.

evidence.source: Code review records for merged changes
evidence.method: Export from the source control platform

evidence.source: Security test results in the build pipeline

test: Sample 20 merged changes and confirm an approving reviewer who is not the author.
Confirm security tests ran for each release in the period.
Confirm failing security findings were fixed or formally accepted before release.
controls.pass_criteria: Sampled changes have an independent approval and security findings were resolved or accepted before release.
common_gaps: Authors can approve their own changes
Security scanners run but failures are ignored
abstain_when: Review metadata for the period is not exported

controls.title: Production changes are approved and reversible
controls.objective: Every production change has a recorded approval and a rollback plan, and deployments match the change records.

evidence.source: Change records with approval and rollback plan
Deployment log for production

test: Sample 20 production changes and confirm approval before deployment.
Confirm each high-risk change has a documented rollback plan.
Compare the deployment log with change records and count deployments with no record.
controls.pass_criteria: Sampled changes were approved before deployment, high-risk changes have rollback plans, and no deployment is unrecorded.
common_gaps: Emergency changes approved after the fact with no review
Deployment logs not linked to change tickets
abstain_when: The deployment log is not retained for the period

controls.title: Internet-facing applications are penetration tested
controls.objective: Every internet-facing application is tested by an independent tester every 12 months, and critical and high findings are retested after fixing.

evidence.source: Penetration test reports and the remediation tracker

test: Confirm a test covered each internet-facing application in the last 12 months, including APIs.
Confirm critical and high findings were verified fixed by retest.
Confirm the tester is independent of the team that built the system.
controls.pass_criteria: Each internet-facing application was tested in the last 12 months and critical and high findings were verified fixed.
common_gaps: APIs excluded from scope
Findings marked fixed without a retest
abstain_when: No test report exists for the period

companions.question: Which controls support both ISO 27001 and PCI DSS?
requires: Framework references for each framework compared (PCI DSS is not in the catalogue yet)

companions.name: Drift AI
companions.question: What changed since last quarter that reduced our Architecture Integrity Score?
requires: Dated configuration exports for two periods
Architecture Integrity Score definition (not yet defined)

companions.name: Engineering AI Coach
companions.question: Why is the API team scoring lower than the Platform team?

companions.name: Cloud AI Advisor
companions.question: What three cloud issues should we fix first to reduce risk fastest?
requires: Impact ratings from the asset inventory

companions.name: Debt Reduction AI
companions.question: What remediation activities reduce the most debt per engineering hour?
requires: Open findings with effort estimates (effort data not yet defined)

companions.name: Assurance AI
companions.question: Which controls are trending toward failure?
requires: At least two assessment periods of control results

companions.name: Forecast AI
companions.question: If we delay remediation 90 days, what happens to risk exposure?
requires: A validated risk-growth model (not yet defined)

companions.name: Audit AI
companions.question: Show all evidence supporting SOC 2 CC6 controls.

companions.name: Route Planner AI
companions.question: What's the optimal remediation sequence for maximum risk reduction?
requires: Cost and effort inputs (not yet defined)

companions.name: Health AI
companions.question: Why did our Cyber Health Score decline by seven points?
requires: Cyber Health Score definition (not yet defined)

companions.name: Executive AI Advisor

companions.question: Which teams are responsible for the majority of unresolved high risks?
requires: Owner on every risk and finding (ISN-GOV-02)

companions.name: Maturity AI

requires: Maturity model with level definitions (not yet defined)
